claims.evidence: No close-up shots of surface condition, ports, or any UK region marking (serial sticker, plug type) are available to confirm cleanliness or origin.
Photo 0 shows only one controller in front of the console; no second controller is visible.
No cables, box, or extra accessories are shown in the photo.
No discs, game cases, or a console menu/library screen showing installed titles are visible.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal fault (common with used PS4 units, e.g. HDMI port failure, overheating).
risks.proof: A video clip of the console powering on and displaying the home screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as untested/worst-case, i.e. as if non-functional.

risks.risk: Missing second controller despite seller's claim.
risks.proof: A photo showing both controllers together, powered on or paired.

risks.risk: No power cable, HDMI cable, or original box included, which affects resale completeness.
risks.proof: A photo of the full bundle including cables and box.

risks.risk: Claimed 10 licensed games (including FC24) may not exist or may be pirated/unlicensed copies.
risks.proof: A photo of the console's game library screen or physical discs with visible titles.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as console-only, no games included.

risks.risk: Storage capacity unknown, affecting value (500GB vs 1TB models differ in price).
risks.proof: A photo of the system storage settings screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lowest standard capacity (500GB).

risks.risk: Port and casing wear/damage not visible (scratches, broken HDMI port, etc.).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rear ports and top/bottom casing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cosmetically average with possible port wear.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen
Photo of both controllers together, ideally connected/paired
Photo of included cables (power, HDMI) and box if available
Photo of the system storage/settings screen showing capacity
Photo of the game library or physical game cases showing titles, especially FC24
Close-up photos of rear ports and console casing for wear/damage
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a genuine Sony PlayStation 4 with one controller, but several seller claims (second pad, accessories, games, UK origin, cleanliness) are unverified or contradicted by the single photo, so it must be priced at worst case pending further proof.
